name: Expensify
description: The Expensify MCP server lets you connect Claude directly to your Expensify account. Once connected, you can ask questions about expenses, reports, reimbursements, receipts, trips, chats, tasks, invoices, and spending trends directly from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Expensify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Expensify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.expensify.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Expensify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expensify provides these MCP tools: GetCurrentUser, GetWorkspaceList, and Search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Expensify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Expensify in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Expensify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Expensify is developed by Expensify, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
